items.content: Indonesia is taking charge of its AI future. This week, the Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi), Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison (Indosat or IOH), NVIDIA and Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM) launched the UGM Indosat NVIDIA AI Technology Center (NVAITC) in Yogyakarta — the country’s first university-based AI technology center. Established under Indonesia’s AI Center of Excellence initiative, UGM Indosat NVAITC brings government, industry and academia together to develop AI that addresses Indonesia’s most urgent national priorities. “The Indonesia AI Center of Excellence reflects our long-term vision to position Indonesia as a nation that not only adopts AI but also develops and contributes AI innovations to the world,” said Meutya Hafid, Indonesia’s Minister of Communication and Digital Affairs. “Through initiatives like this, we are laying the foundations of Indonesia’s AI sovereignty and ensuring AI becomes a driver of economic growth, national competitiveness and solutions to Indonesia’s most pressing challenges.” “UGM is committed to supporting Indonesia’s AI ambitions through education, research, and innovation that deliver real societal impact,” said Prof. dr. Ova Emilia, Ph.D. “This initiative supports national priorities in higher education, research downstreaming and talent development by accelerating the adoption of AI and preparing future-ready Indonesian talent.” Compute That Belongs to the Country Powered by NVIDIA’s full-stack AI platform and GPU Merdeka — Indosat’s sovereign GPU-as-a-service platform — UGM Indosat NVAITC gives UGM’s researchers and students access to enterprise-grade accelerated computing, AI software, open source, pretrained models, development frameworks and technical mentorship. It also connects Indonesian researchers to a worldwide ecosystem of expertise. “At Indosat, we believe no Indonesian should be left behind in the AI era,” said Vikram Sinha, president director and CEO of Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison. “Through UGM Indosat NVAITC, we are bringing the best of global AI technologies and expertise to Indonesia, while expanding access for the ecosystem of researchers, students, startups, and innovators across the country. By strengthening AI readiness and empowering Indonesian talent, we aim to support the government’s vision for AI and help position Indonesia not only as a user of AI technologies, but as a nation that develops and contributes AI innovations to the world.” The opportunity is real. Indonesia is the world’s fourth-most populous country, with researchers and developers working on problems of scale and urgency. What they’ve historically lacked is access to the compute, models and infrastructure to move from insight to impact. “Indonesia is home to an extraordinary community of researchers, developers and innovators with the potential to shape the future of AI,” said Marc Hamilton, vice president of solutions architecture and engineering at NVIDIA. “From healthcare and agriculture to disaster preparedness, the opportunities for AI to drive real change are immense. Through UGM Indosat NVIDIA AI Technology Center, NVIDIA is committed to equipping Indonesian talent with NVIDIA Nemotron open models and expertise to turn that potential into innovation with local and global impact.” AI for Indonesian Challenges Three initial projects define what this center is for, focused on healthcare, agriculture and natural disaster response. Indonesia records over 1 million new tuberculosis (TB) cases every year. TB is curable — but it kills when it goes undetected. Detection in rural and underserved areas has depended on equipment and expertise unavailable at the community level. UGM’s Faculty of Medicine Public Health and Nursing team, led by dr. Dian Kesumapramudya Nurputra, M.Sc, Ph.D, SpA , is developing an AI-powered electronic screening technology — eNose-TB — that screens for TB by analyzing breath samples. The goal: affordable, fast, accessible screening that reaches patients in remote clinics and villages — no specialist or expensive lab required. “As researchers, we have always believed that technology developed in Indonesia can solve Indonesian challenges,” said Dian. “Through the center, access to world-class AI infrastructure and expertise will help us accelerate our research and bring us closer to our dream of developing affordable and accessible healthcare technologies that can improve lives across Indonesia.” Agriculture employs nearly 30% of Indonesia’s workforce. SmartAgri uses multimodal AI — combining satellite imagery, sensor data and local agricultural knowledge — alongside edge computing to deliver precision farming for Indonesian terrain, crops and smallholders. These AI-powered recommendations help farmers know exactly when and how to irrigate, delivering impact that compounds over time. Indonesia sits on the Pacific Ring of Fire, facing more natural disaster risk than almost anywhere on earth. Tech4Disaster is building a geospatial AI platform using NVIDIA accelerated computing to process satellite and sensor data at speed — giving communities and emergency responders earlier warning, better situational awareness and faster coordination tools when disaster strikes. Learn more about the UGM Indosat NVIDIA AI Technology Center.

items.titleZh: Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat and NVIDIA Open Indonesia’s First University AI Center to Develop Local AI Talent
items.descriptionZh:
印度尼西亚正在加快掌控本国人工智能未来的步伐。本周，印尼通信与数字事务部（Komdigi）、运营商Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison（IOH）、英伟达（NVIDIA）与加查马达大学（UGM）在日惹共同启动了“UGM Indosat NVIDIA AI技术中心”（NVAITC），这是该国首个依托大学建立的AI技术中心。该中心是“印尼AI卓越中心”（Indonesia AI Center of Excellence）计划的一部分，旨在将政府、产业界和学术界的力量汇聚在一起，围绕印尼最紧迫的国家优先事项开发AI解决方案。

印尼通信与数字事务部长梅蒂亚·哈菲德（Meutya Hafid）表示，AI卓越中心体现了该国长期愿景，即让印尼不仅成为AI技术的采用者，更成为全球AI创新的开发者和贡献者。她强调，这类举措正在为印尼的“AI主权”奠定基础，确保AI成为经济增长、国家竞争力以及解决重大挑战的驱动力。UGM校长奥瓦·埃米利亚教授（Prof. dr. Ova Emilia）也表示，该中心通过加速AI应用和培养面向未来的人才，支持高等教育、研究转化和人才培养等国家优先事项。

从技术基础设施看，该中心由英伟达全栈AI平台和Indosat的“GPU Merdeka”——一个主权GPU即服务平台——提供算力支持。研究人员和学生可以获得企业级加速计算资源、AI软件、开源预训练模型、开发框架以及技术指导。中心还帮助印尼研究人员连接全球AI专家生态。Indosat总裁兼首席执行官维克拉姆·辛哈（Vikram Sinha）强调，他们希望让任何印尼人都能跟上AI时代的步伐，通过引入全球最先进的AI技术和专业知识，为国内的研究人员、学生、初创企业和创新者扩大机会。英伟达解决方案架构与工程副总裁马克·汉密尔顿（Marc Hamilton）则指出，印尼拥有非凡的研究者、开发者和创新者社区，而在医疗、农业、灾害应对等领域，AI变革潜力巨大。该中心将使用英伟达NVIDIA Nemotron开放模型和专业知识，帮助印尼人才把潜力转化为具有本地和全球影响力的创新。

中心首批启动的三个项目紧扣印尼本土挑战，覆盖医疗、农业和自然灾害响应。

在医疗领域，印尼每年新增超过100万例结核病（TB）病例。结核病本可治愈，但若未被及时发现则可能致命。在偏远和欠发达地区，检测往往依赖社区层面所不具备的设备和专业知识。UGM公共卫生与护理学院团队在Dian Kesumapramudya Nurputra博士的带领下，正在开发名为“eNose-TB”的AI电子筛查技术，通过分析呼吸样本来筛查结核病。其目标是提供廉价、快速、可及性强的筛查手段，让偏远诊所和村庄的患者无需专业医生或昂贵实验室即可获得检测。该技术有望大幅改善印尼结核病高负担地区的早期诊断率。

在农业方面，印尼近30%的劳动力从事农业。“SmartAgri”项目利用多模态AI——结合卫星图像、传感器数据和本地农业知识——以及边缘计算，为印尼的地形、作物和小农户提供精准农业方案。这些AI驱动的建议帮助农民准确掌握灌溉时机和方法，并通过长期累积产生持续的增产增效和资源节约效果。

在防灾领域，印尼位于环太平洋火山地震带，几乎比地球上任何地方都面临更多的自然灾害风险。“Tech4Disaster”项目正在构建一个地理空间AI平台，利用英伟达加速计算快速处理卫星和传感器数据，为社区和应急响应人员提供更早的预警、更强的态势感知以及更快的协调工具，从而在灾害发生时显著提升响应效率。

总体而言，UGM Indosat NVIDIA AI技术中心的成立，标志着印尼在推动AI主权、培养本土AI人才和解决国家关键问题方面迈出实质性一步。它通过将全球领先的AI基础设施、开放模型与本地研究需求深度结合，正在把印尼从单纯的AI用户转变为AI创新的参与者和贡献者，并为医疗、农业和减灾等关系国计民生的领域带来切实可行的先进解决方案。

items.title: Scythe Magoroku Review: excellent RAM thermals, but needs improvement elsewhere
items.description: Scythe is back with another dual-tower air cooler, the Magoroku. This cooler performs best with an Intel Arrow Lake system.
items.content: Unlike some of its cooler competitors, Chiba Japan-based Scythe is a fabless company that partners with factories in China and Taiwan for manufacturing of its air coolers, fans, and other PC hardware. The company has been delivering cooling products aimed largely at quiet performance for more than 20 years. We’ve enjoyed testing its previous products, like the fan-favorite FUMA 3 air cooler. Today we’re looking at Scythe’s latest offering, the Magoroku – a dual tower heatsink paired with two of Scythe’s Wonder Tornado 120 fans. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Included with the package are:● Mounting hardware for AMD and Intel platforms● Three sets of fan clips● A small tube of thermal paste● Two 120mm Wonder Tornado fans● Screwdriver (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)AM5 InstallationTo begin putting things together, you’ll need to first remove the default AM4/5 retention mechanism. Next, place the studs over the exposed holes. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Afterwards, take the mounting bars and secure them with the included screws and screwdriver. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)It’s time to apply the thermal compound. If you’re not sure how to do that, we have a handy thermal paste application guide that covers the best methods you can use.After thermal paste is applied, take the CPU block and press it against the mounting bars, using the built-in screws and screwdriver to secure it in place. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Finally, you’ll want to attach both fans using the clips included with the cooler and connect them to the motherboard’s PWM header. If you have tall system RAM, I advise moving the front fan and placing it in the rear for best thermal performance. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Real-world testing configuration on AMD’s AM5 platformWe’ve tested coolers with both the Ryzen 9950X3D and its non-V-Cache sibling, the 9950X. There are some differences in how the 9950X and 9950X3D CPUs are impacted by thermal events. While the heat output of the CCDs of AMD’s 9950X3D is relatively balanced, the 9950X I used has one CCD that runs much hotter than the other, with a difference of over 10 degrees Celsius in some scenarios, shown below. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)We’ve since returned to using a 9950X3D for cooler testing, as it has a more balanced heat profile, and is almost certainly a more widely adopted CPU. The benchmark results shared in these reviews may differ from others because I emphasize results that are comparable to real-world use. This means I generally test CPU coolers inside of a closed desktop case, which increases cooling difficulty compared to other testing methods.Many reviewers test coolers on open test benches, which have a combination of lesser airflow needs and lowered ambient temperatures. This results in making weak coolers appear stronger than they really are. Some publications have also used generic thermal plates to test cooling solutions. I reject both of these methods because they don’t accurately reflect real-world cooler conditions. items.titleZh: Scythe Magoroku 评测：内存散热表现出色，但其他方面仍需改进
items.descriptionZh:
日本千叶的Scythe（镰刀）是一家无晶圆厂PC硬件厂商，与中台工厂合作生产空气散热器、风扇等产品，20余年来一直专注于安静性能表现，其此前的FUMA 3风冷散热器广受好评。本次评测的是Scythe最新型号Magoroku——一款双塔散热器，标配两把Wonder Tornado 120风扇，官方建议零售价42.99美元，目前亚马逊售价38.69美元，属于中端风冷产品。

Magoroku采用双塔鳍片设计，六根铜热管将CPU热量传导至两侧散热鳍片。整机尺寸为134×142.5×155mm，兼容AMD AM5/AM4和Intel LGA 1700/1851/1200/115x平台。散热器不配备RGB灯效，质保期为一年。标配的风扇为120mm Wonder Tornado，转速区间300–2000 RPM，风量60.29 CFM，风压2.45 mmH2O，厚度26mm。

内存兼容性是这款散热器的设计亮点之一。官方参数标称支持57mm以下高度的内存，但若在前方安装标配风扇，高马甲内存会与风扇产生遮挡，影响散热效率。评测者建议的最佳方案是：将前置风扇移至散热器后部、主板VRM散热片上方，这样既能获得最佳散热性能，又能完全兼容高内存，不会对DIMM槽产生任何干涉。

安装过程：在AM5平台上，先移除原装扣具，放置螺柱并固定安装条，涂抹硅脂后将CPU底座用自带螺丝固定，最后通过风扇夹安装两把风扇并连接到主板PWM接口。包装内附赠了AMD和Intel平台安装套件、三组风扇夹、一管硅脂、两把风扇和一把螺丝刀。

值得注意的测试方法：评测者强调自己坚持在封闭机箱内测试，而不是使用开放式测试台或通用均热板，因为后两种方法会低估散热器在真实机箱中的散热难度，使弱散热器显得更强。测试平台采用AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D、MSI X870E Carbon主板、TeamGroup DDR5-7200内存、MSI RTX 4070Ti Super显卡，机箱为Tryx FLOVA F50（独特横流风扇设计，另加一把Noctua NF-A12 G2进风扇）。之所以选用9950X3D而非9950X，是因为前者CCD发热更均衡，更贴近主流用户实际使用情况。

实测性能：在封闭机箱环境下，Magoroku在全速风扇下可压制超过236W的CPU功耗；在噪音归一化测试（将风扇转速调整至标准噪音水平）中，平均可处理超过228W功耗。考虑到其40美元左右的价位，这款散热器在静音、兼容性和散热能力之间取得了不错的平衡，有望进入最佳CPU散热器推荐榜单。对于希望搭配高端Ryzen处理器并追求安静运行的用户，Magoroku是一个值得考虑的选项。不过最终性能评级还需结合完整的风扇曲线、噪音实测以及与其他同价位产品的横向对比来判断。

items.title: Cargo thieves ram security escorts to hijack AI hardware shipments in California — brazen thieves employ PIT maneuver, rear-ending tactics to secure goods for the black market
items.description: Cargo thieves knocked two private security escort vehicles out of action on California roads in recent months, then made off with millions of dollars in AI data center hardware.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 7 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Cargo thieves knocked two private security escort vehicles out of action on California roads in recent months, then made off with millions of dollars in AI data center hardware the escorts were guarding, according to a WIRED investigation. Both shipments were traveling from Silicon Valley to Southern California, and neither truck has been recovered. The attacks come as cargo theft losses across the U.S. and Canada more than doubled year over year to $304.6 million in Q2 2026, and as restricted Nvidia servers sell in China for roughly twice their U.S. retail price.Gerardo Pachuca, a former Los Angeles sheriff's detective who now consults on cargo crime, told WIRED that one escort was rear-ended by a driver who fled the scene, while the other was spun off the road with a PIT maneuver, the same tactic police use to end car chases. Once the escorts were disabled, the semitrucks kept driving and disappeared. Investigators believe the truck drivers were complicit, with both thefts involving motor carrier numbers that had recently changed hands, a fraud technique that lets criminals book freight under a legitimate company's federal registration. "It's the worst I've seen," Pachuca said of cargo theft nationwide.WIRED couldn't confirm the incidents with five state and local law enforcement agencies, but two freight security figures corroborated them: J.J. Coughlin, chairman of the Southwest Transportation Security Council, and Danny Ramon, director of intelligence and response at freight-monitoring firm Overhaul.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Verisk CargoNet documented 677 supply chain theft incidents in the U.S. and Canada in Q2 2026, down 26% from a year earlier, yet estimated losses jumped from $135.7 million to $304.6 million over the same period, according to a recent report by the firm. The average theft with a reported value hit $564,009. "Lower incident volume should not be mistaken for lower risk," said Keith Lewis, vice president of operations at Verisk CargoNet.Enterprise computing and networking equipment ranks among the most targeted categories, and Verisk noted that shipments worth several million dollars routinely move as conventional dry freight with no special security. Recoveries this summer included $550,000 in Celestica-built server switches destined for Meta and roughly $1 million in data center equipment found in a trailer outside Chicago. You may like Cargo thieves target AI data center supplies in $1.3 million heists Nvidia employee implicated in escalating AI GPU smuggling scandal Taiwan raids 12 locations in its first formal crackdown on Nvidia AI chip smuggling Freight investigators, including Pachuca, told WIRED that location pings from stolen components suggest many shipments end up overseas. Stolen cargo normally fences at a steep discount, but U.S. export controls have pushed black market prices in China far above American retail: Nvidia's DGX B300 server sells there for more than $1.1 million against a U.S. price of roughly $550,000, and even five-year-old A100 servers have tripled in price. A hijacked truckload of restricted AI hardware is one of the few categories of stolen goods that can be worth more on the black market than off of it. items.titleZh: Cargo thieves ram security escorts to hijack AI hardware shipments in California — brazen thieves employ PIT maneuver, rear-ending tactics to secure goods for the black market
items.descriptionZh:
近期美国加州发生两起针对AI数据中心硬件运输的精心策划的劫案。据WIRED调查，两辆私人安保护送车在公路上被撞毁，护送的价值数百万美元的AI数据中心硬件被劫走。两批货物均从硅谷运往南加州，目前卡车均未找回。这些攻击发生之际，北美地区货物盗窃损失在2026年第二季度同比增长一倍以上，达到3.046亿美元，而受限的Nvidia服务器在中国黑市售价约为美国零售价的两倍。

前洛杉矶县警探Gerardo Pachuca介绍，其中一辆护卫车被肇事逃逸的司机追尾，另一辆则被PIT机动（警方用来结束追车战的战术）撞出道路。护卫车辆瘫痪后，半挂卡车继续行驶并消失。调查人员认为卡车司机是同谋，两起盗窃案都涉及近期易手的承运商编号。这是一种欺诈技术，犯罪分子可利用合法公司的联邦注册信息预订货运。Pachuca称这是他所见过最严重的货物盗窃。

WIRED未能从五个州和地方执法机构获得确认，但两位货运安全人士证实了事件。Verisk CargoNet报告显示，2026年Q2美国和加拿大共记录677起供应链盗窃事件，同比下降26%，但估计损失从1.357亿美元跃升至3.046亿美元。有报告价值的盗窃案平均损失达56.4万美元。Verisk副总裁Keith Lewis表示，事件数量降低不应被误认为风险降低。企业计算和网络设备是最常被盯上的类别之一，价值数百万美元的货物经常以普通干货运输，没有特殊安保。今年夏天追回的物品包括价值55万美元、为Meta制造的Celestica服务器交换机，以及在芝加哥附近拖车内发现的约100万美元数据中心设备。

货运调查人员指出，被盗部件的定位信号显示许多货物最终流向海外。通常赃物以折扣价销赃，但美国出口管制推高了中国黑市价格：Nvidia DGX B300服务器在中国售价超过110万美元，而美国零售价约55万美元；即使是五年前的A100服务器价格也已涨了三倍。因此，一整车受限AI硬件是少数在黑市上比合法市场更值钱的赃物。这起事件凸显了AI芯片供应链面临的新安全挑战。

items.title: Older Raptor Lake CPUs are a ‘core part of the portfolio’ for years to come, says Intel — there’s been a ‘sudden inrush of demand’ for LGA 1700 chips due to DDR5 prices
items.description: Intel has seen a “sudden inrush” of demand for Raptor Lake CPUs, and it says they’ll remain a part of the company’s lineup for desktop builders “for years to come.”
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 9 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Intel’s Robert Hallock, vice president and general manager of Intel’s enthusiast channel business, told Tom’s Hardware Premium in an interview that the Raptor Lake architecture will be part of Intel’s offerings “for years to come.” Intel has no plans to abandon Raptor Lake, and if anything, the company says it’s working to “smooth out” some of the supply and pricing inconsistencies among the range. Raptor Lake CPUs still rank among the best CPUs for gaming, not only due to the underperforming Arrow Lake (not Refresh), but also due to high DDR5 prices.Go deeper with TH Premium: CPU (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)CPU scaling with DLSSRyzen to the top: How AMD innovated in the gaming CPU marketHow ARM is working its way into PCsAMD CES 2026 gaming trends press Q&A roundtable transcript“Going forward, 10nm products like Raptor Lake; that is a core part of the portfolio that I want to offer to people for years to come,” said Hallock. “LGA 1700 is still a good socket. Lots of people [are] still interested in DDR4, so [we’ll] keep offering, and you'll see [pricing] smooth out over time. It'll come back to normal. That's the plan.”Raptor Lake has become a key part of Intel’s roadmap as the RAM shortage strangles budget builders from upgrading to a DDR5 platform. In June, Tom’s Hardware first reported on motherboard manufacturers increasing production of DDR4-based boards with the LGA 1700 socket (the socket Raptor Lake CPUs use), and we’re seeing those products roll out now. Just days ago, in fact, Gigabyte introduced a new LGA 1700 board with DDR4 support.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Motherboards were one issue with Raptor Lake on DDR4 platforms; there were never a ton of LGA 1700 motherboards with DDR4 support to begin with. They were something of a stopgap with 12th-Gen Alder Lake CPUs as Intel transitioned to DDR5, largely falling out of favor (and inventory) as Raptor Lake rolled out and DDR5 prices started coming down. Obviously we’re living in a much different world now.But as the DDR5 pricing crisis started hitting, Raptor Lake inventory started faltering, in part due to increased demand (at least according to Hallock), and likely also in part due to the gradual phasing out of older products. Today, the pricing situation with Raptor Lake is problematic. The Core i5-14600K, for example, sold for $200 or less for the better part of last year. It’s since jumped to around $250, if you can find it in stock at all. At the time of writing, it’s on backorder at Newegg and $262 at Amazon. Similarly, the Core i7-14700K should be selling for around $330, but it’s $380 at Newegg at the time of writing and sold out at Amazon. Again, for the majority of last year, the 14700K often sold for less than $350. You may like Intel reportedly preparing surprise return to DDR4 systems with 'Raptor Lake Next' Intel's upcoming Raptor Lake Next will reportedly top out at 20 cores and retain Core 200 branding Re-examining the DDR4 gaming gap with Intel’s LGA 1700 CPUs in mid-2026 This wobbly inventory and pricing situation is due to the “sudden inrush of demand” for Raptor Lake CPUs as the RAM pricing crisis started to take hold, and Intel didn’t see it coming. “If people are going to go to more affordable hardware, they still want the fastest available for their money, and that happened to be Alder Lake and Raptor Lake. So there was a sudden inrush of demand into these parts — certainly not anticipated when you start your wafers, and your builds, long before that moment ever happens. So it's very hard to predict,” Hallock said.And Raptor Lake CPUs do remain top DDR4 performers. In our recent re-review of the Ryzen 7 5800X3D, the Core i7-14700K and 13700K matched the 5800X3D in games, all three of which were using DDR4, and offered much better application performance. In our recent comparison of DDR4 against DDR5 across Intel’s LGA 1700 stack, we found that DDR4 is the major bottleneck in games, which is something even the 5800X3D can’t overcome.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsHallock indicates that we’ll see an increase in Raptor Lake inventory, though he didn’t specify what that inventory will look like. As Tom’s Hardware first reported in June, motherboard vendors are gearing up for “Raptor Lake Next,” which is supposedly another slate of refreshes set to launch at the beginning of next year. There are also Bartlett Lake processors that use strictly P-cores, exclusively for embedded applications. Although they haven’t made their way to DIY desktops, the range shows that Intel continues to produce 10nm products and likely will for several years in the future.Although Intel is making efforts to improve Raptor Lake supply — be that through more stock or Raptor Lake Next — that isn’t coming at the cost of next-gen Nova Lake parts. Hallock indicated that Intel, as well as the industry more broadly, is looking at splitting mainstream and enthusiast offerings due to pricing pressure elsewhere in the market. You can read the transcript of the full interview at our Tom's Hardware Premium site. items.titleZh: 英特尔表示，较老的Raptor Lake CPU在未来几年仍是‘产品组合的核心部分’——由于DDR5价格，LGA 1700芯片出现了‘突发需求涌入’
items.descriptionZh:
英特尔副总裁兼发烧友渠道业务总经理Robert Hallock在接受Tom’s Hardware Premium采访时明确表示，Raptor Lake架构将成为英特尔未来数年产品组合的核心组成部分，公司没有放弃这一架构的打算，反而正在努力解决当前该系列产品在供应和定价上的混乱局面。尽管Arrow Lake（非Refresh版本）表现不及预期，加上DDR5内存价格居高不下，Raptor Lake处理器依然是游戏领域的最佳选择之一。

Hallock在采访中指出：“面向未来，像Raptor Lake这样的10nm产品是我希望长期提供给用户的核心组合。LGA 1700仍然是一个优秀的插槽，很多人依然对DDR4感兴趣，所以我们会继续提供相关产品，你会看到价格随时间逐渐趋于平稳，最终恢复正常。这就是我们的计划。”这番表态的背景是，DDR5内存短缺正严重制约预算型装机用户向DDR5平台升级，Raptor Lake因此成为英特尔路线图上的关键一环。

事实上，早在6月份，Tom’s Hardware就曾报道过主板厂商正在提高采用LGA 1700插槽的DDR4主板产量——LGA 1700正是Raptor Lake所用的插槽。如今这些产品已经陆续上市，就在几天前，技嘉还推出了一款支持DDR4的新LGA 1700主板。过去，支持DDR4的LGA 1700主板数量一直不多，它们在12代酷睿Alder Lake时代作为英特尔向DDR5过渡的权宜之计存在，但随着Raptor Lake推出和DDR5价格下降，这些主板逐渐失宠并退出了库存。如今情况则完全不同。

随着DDR5价格危机加剧，Raptor Lake本身的库存也开始吃紧，部分原因是需求增加（至少按Hallock的说法如此），部分原因可能是旧产品逐渐停产。当前Raptor Lake的定价问题相当突出：例如酷睿i5-14600K去年大部分时间售价在200美元或更低，现在却涨到约250美元，还常常缺货。截至撰稿时，该处理器在Newegg上处于缺货状态，在亚马逊上标价262美元。同样，酷睿i7-14700K原本应在330美元左右，现在Newegg上标价380美元，亚马逊则已售罄，而去年大部分时间它经常低于350美元。

Hallock将这种不稳定的库存和价格状况归因于内存价格危机开始后Raptor Lake需求的“突然涌入”，而英特尔对此毫无预料。“如果人们打算转向更经济的硬件，他们仍然希望在同等预算下获得最快的产品，而恰好在当时最合适的就是Alder Lake和Raptor Lake。因此这些部件出现了突然的需求激增——当你开始晶圆投片和生产备货时，很难预料到未来会发生什么，所以这非常难以预测。”

从性能角度看，Raptor Lake依然是DDR4平台上的顶级存在。在我们近期对Ryzen 7 5800X3D的重新评测中，酷睿i7-14700K和13700K在游戏性能上与5800X3D持平，三者均使用DDR4内存，而英特尔芯片还提供了明显更好的应用性能。在我们另一项针对英特尔LGA 1700产品线的DDR4与DDR5对比测试中发现，DDR4是游戏中的主要瓶颈，这是连5800X3D也无法克服的。

Hallock表示Raptor Lake的库存会得到改善，但他没有具体说明未来的库存规模。正如Tom’s Hardware在6月首次报道的那样，主板厂商正在为“Raptor Lake Next”做准备——这据称是定于明年年初发布的又一波刷新产品。此外还有仅使用P核、专供嵌入式应用的Bartlett Lake处理器。虽然它们尚未进入DIY桌面市场，但该产品线表明英特尔仍在持续生产10nm产品，且很可能在未来数年都会如此。

值得注意的是，尽管英特尔在努力改善Raptor Lake的供应——无论是通过增加库存还是推出Raptor Lake Next——这并不会以牺牲下一代Nova Lake部件为代价。Hallock指出，英特尔乃至更广泛的行业正考虑将主流产品与发烧友产品线分离开来，以应对市场其他方面的定价压力。完整访谈实录可在Tom’s Hardware Premium网站查阅。

items.title: Nvidia Jetson chip found in Russian cruise missile, Ukraine claims — presence in S-71 'Monochrome' weapon may indicate use of AI tech
items.description: Ukraine intelligence claims that Russia's latest S-71 'Monochrome' cruise missiles use Nvidia's Jetson Orin NX modules with AI capabilities, allegedly for terminal guidance.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 3 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Russia's latest S-71 'Monochrome' cruise missiles use Nvidia's Jetson Orin modules with artificial intelligence capabilities, the Main Directorate of Intelligence of the Ministry of Defense of Ukraine claimed on Wednesday. The S-71 'Monochrome' is distinguished by reduced observability and autonomous targeting capability, reports Militarnyi. Nvidia says the Jetson Orin is a consumer-grade device that is not export-controlled and is not officially available in Russia.According to the claims, the module in question carries an Nvidia chip marked as SNVUP6.MOP TE980M-A1 and resembles the Jetson Orin NX 8GB/16GB system-on-module. The Orin NX is an automotive-grade SoM based on a system-on-chip featuring up to eight Arm Cortex-A78AE cores, a GPU featuring Ampere architecture with 1024 CUDA cores and 32 Tensor cores that provide up to 157 sparse INT8 TOPS performance for AI, dedicated NVDLA engines, and a vision accelerator. The unit has been shipping since 2023, though based on the markings on the chip purportedly found in the missile, it was packaged in March, 2025."Our Jetson Orin modules are consumer-grade products sold to students, developers, and startups for a wide range of beneficial applications," an Nvidia spokesperson told Tom's Hardware. "They are not available in Russia and are not designed for military purposes. Pre-owned Jetsons are available through many reseller channels. Although we cannot track products after they are sold, if we determine that any customer is violating U.S. export controls, we will take appropriate action."Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Nvidia positions Jetson Orin NX as a solution for space- and power-constrained applications that need vision, but cannot accommodate more powerful and power-hungry solutions, which essentially means drones and mobile robots that work on battery power. Conceptually, an Orin NX could function as a dedicated electro-optical perception computer that can recognize images locally and pass the information to a separate flight-control/guidance system.In the S-71 'Monochrome' missile, capabilities of Nvidia's Jetson Orin NX are potentially useful as the compute engine behind an electro-optical perception system (based on a Honpho TS130C-01 module that is made in China) that recognizes images in real time and assists terminal guidance. As per Militarnyi, the S-71M 'Monochrome' can be fired from Su-57 fighters or S-70 Okhotnik drones. With a range of up to 300km, it carries a 250k high-explosive fragmentation bomb as its payload. You may like Chinese military has been acquiring Nvidia chips, even post-Washington export controls, research claims China's Moonshot AI reportedly used Nvidia Blackwell chips for training Kimi K3 Jensen Huang slams 'stupid' analogy comparing GPUs to nuclear weapons Previously, Ukrainian intelligence reported that Russia used Nvidia's Jetson Orin NX modules in its Shahed MS001 autonomous drones for local decision-making and terminal guidance.Nvidia's Jetson Orin NX modules have been shipping since 2023 and are widely available, which means that Nvidia sells hundreds of thousands, if not millions, every year. Meanwhile, the majority of Jetson Orin NX-based products available in retail are not the SoMs themselves, but rather small-form-factor systems or development kits. The modules are available too, though not as widely. For example, a German store sells them for €685 with a 19% VAT.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsIn any case, while the American government does export control for high-end AI accelerators like Nvidia's H100 or B200, which can be used to train AI models that can later be used for military purposes, it does not export control hardware that can run these models locally. Ultimately, the models are trained anyway, and the hardware that can use them is readily available. items.titleZh: 乌克兰声称在俄罗斯巡航导弹中发现英伟达Jetson芯片——S-71“单色”武器中的存在可能表明使用了AI技术
items.descriptionZh:
乌克兰国防部情报总局近日声称，俄罗斯最新型的S-71“Monochrome”（单色）巡航导弹中集成了英伟达（Nvidia）的Jetson Orin人工智能模块，用于提升导弹的自主目标识别与制导能力。这一消息由乌克兰军事媒体Militarnyi率先披露，并引发了关于商用AI芯片在军事武器中应用及出口管制有效性的讨论。

据乌克兰方面公布的信息，俄军在S-71导弹中使用的芯片标记为“SNVUP6.MOP TE980M-A1”，外观与英伟达Jetson Orin NX 8GB/16GB系统级模块（SoM）高度吻合。该模块基于英伟达Orin系统级芯片（SoC）设计，集成多达8个Arm Cortex-A78AE处理器核心，以及基于Ampere架构的GPU，内含1024个CUDA核心和32个Tensor核心，可提供高达157 TOPS（稀疏INT8精度）的AI算力，并配备专用的NVDLA深度学习加速引擎和视觉加速器。该系列模块自2023年起量产推向市场，但导弹中发现的这颗芯片封装日期显示为2025年3月，意味着其供应链很可能在近期仍能向俄罗斯输送此类硬件。

英伟达公司回应称，Jetson Orin模块属于消费级产品，面向学生、开发者及初创公司设计，并非军用产品，且英伟达不在俄罗斯官方销售该产品。不过，英伟达也承认，该模块并非出口管制对象，且大量二手或转售渠道流通的模块难以追踪。公司强调，一旦确认客户违反美国出口管制政策，将采取适当行动。

S-71“Monochrome”巡航导弹的突出特点在于低可观测性（隐身设计）和自主目标捕获能力。导弹射程可达300公里，可搭载一枚250公斤级高爆杀伤战斗部，并可由苏-57战斗机或S-70“猎人”无人战机发射。据分析，导弹内部搭载的Jetson Orin NX模块充当“光电感知计算大脑”，配合一个中国制造的Honpho TS130C-01光电传感器模块，在飞行末端对目标图像进行实时识别与匹配，从而在不依赖外部数据链或GPS信号的情况下实现“发射后不管”的精确打击。Jetson Orin NX的低功耗、小体积特性，使其非常适合部署在电池供电无人机或便携式武器平台上。

这并非俄罗斯首次在武器系统中使用英伟达AI模块。此前乌克兰情报部门就曾报告，俄军在Shahed MS001型自杀式无人机中也使用了Jetson Orin NX模块，用于本地目标识别和末端制导决策。这说明无论是高端智能弹药还是低成本巡飞弹，俄军都在尝试利用商用AI硬件实现自主作战能力。

从全球硬件流通角度看，Jetson Orin NX模块自2023年开始大规模发货，年销量达数十万甚至上百万件。零售市场上常见的往往是基于该模块的整机或开发套件，裸模块也并非难以获取。例如，有德国零售商公开出售该模块，含19%增值税后售价约685欧元。这一状况折射出当前出口管制体系的一个结构性漏洞：美国政府对英伟达H100、B200等高端AI训练加速器实施严格出口管制，因为这些芯片可用于训练军事AI模型，但对于运行这些模型的边缘推理硬件，如Jetson系列，却并未纳入管制清单。最终结果就是，AI模型可以通过受管制的设备在合法渠道训练出来，而能够部署模型的推理硬件却可轻易流入任何市场。

综上，S-71导弹中发现的英伟达AI模块不仅揭示了商业AI芯片在战场上的快速渗透，也再次引发了对全球AI硬件流通监管的质疑。随着自主武器系统日益依赖商用边缘计算平台，如何平衡技术开放与安全风险，将成为各国政策制定者必须面对的难题。

items.title: AMD borrows $4.75 billion for 'general corporate purposes' — company gives no insight into how it plans to spend cash injection
items.description: In a surprising move, AMD announces plans to raise $4.75 billion and does not give a clue how it plans to spend them.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Coming on the heels of Intel's $19.7 billion common stock offering from earlier this week, AMD on Thursday announced plans to borrow $4.75 billion through a new senior unsecured debt offering. AMD does not tie the proceeds to a particular project, saying they will be available for general corporate purposes, including potentially paying down existing debt. Meanwhile, the increasing capital intensity of the industry gives AMD numerous options to use the money."We intend to use the net proceeds from this offering for general corporate purposes, which may include the repayment of debt," an AMD statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission reads.The offering comprises four tranches: $1.25 billion of 4.6% notes due in 2029; $1.50 billion of 5% notes due in 2031; $1 billion of 5.25% notes due in 2033; and $1 billion of 5.5% notes due in 2036. Their yields to maturity are 4.64%, 5.018%, 5.264%, and 5.532%, respectively, while spreads over comparable U.S. Treasuries range from 43 to 90 basis points, which indicates that the market is generally confident in AMD and is willing to lend it money at rates that barely exceed those of the U.S. Treasury. Moody's and S&P are expected to rate the securities A1 and A, respectively.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: AMD did not disclose how it plans to spend $4.75 billion, but the additional money obtained at attractive rates gives it room to finance its increasingly capital-intensive business as well as cash for debt repayment and other corporate requirements.AMD hardly appears desperate for additional money. At the end of Q2 2026, the company had approximately $13.1 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments. AMD's debt totaled $3.2 billion, and only $875 million is classified as current, which means that the proceeds from the offering by far exceed AMD's current obligations. Meanwhile, AMD's business is becoming very capital intensive. You may like Intel raises $19.7 billion to help fund future projects as 14A production looms AMD confirmed $5.4 billion ATI acquisition 20 years ago today Record-high pricing pushes SSD and memory makers to borrow $880 million just to afford buying chips At the end of 2025, the company had around $12.2 billion in unconditional commitments, which include purchases of wafers and substrates, multi-year cloud-service agreements, software and technology licenses, and guaranteed obligations to third parties. Approximately $8.5 billion was due in 2026.Also, AMD's working capital requirements are growing. Inventories reached approximately $8.47 billion by the end of Q2, while accounts payable climbed to $5.36 billion. AMD also spent $1.20 billion on property and equipment during the first half of 2026, compared with $494 million a year earlier.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsIf we were to speculate where AMD can put $4.75 billion, then long-term supply agreements for commodities like memory, logic production, or advanced packaging immediately come to mind. However, given the current market realities, $4.75 billion is 1.8x smaller than AMD's inventories as of late Q2 2026. Furthermore, an average long-term supply deal with a major memory maker now amounts to $7.14 billion (according to Micron's comments made in its recent earnings release).That said, $4.75 billion may not be enough for AMD to make strategically important purchase commitments. Nonetheless, getting nearly $5 billion at attractive rates amid global undersupply of pretty much everything certainly gives AMD some additional flexibility to run its business. items.titleZh: AMD borrows $4.75 billion for 'general corporate purposes' — company gives no insight into how it plans to spend cash injection
items.descriptionZh:
在英特尔本周早些时候宣布通过普通股发行筹集197亿美元之后，AMD于周四跟进，计划通过新的高级无担保债务发行借款47.5亿美元。AMD并未将这笔资金与特定项目挂钩，表示将用于一般公司用途，其中可能包括偿还现有债务。随着行业资本密集度不断上升，这笔资金为AMD提供了多种使用选择。

根据AMD提交给美国证券交易委员会（SEC）的声明，本次发行分为四个批次：12.5亿美元票面利率4.6%的2029年到期票据；15亿美元票面利率5%的2031年到期票据；10亿美元票面利率5.25%的2033年到期票据；以及10亿美元票面利率5.5%的2036年到期票据。对应到期收益率分别为4.64%、5.018%、5.264%和5.532%，相较同期限美国国债的利差在43至90个基点之间。这表明市场对AMD的信用状况总体有信心，愿意以略高于美国国债的利率向其放贷。穆迪和标普预计将分别给予此次发行的证券A1和A的评级。

AMD没有披露47.5亿美元的具体使用计划，但以如此有吸引力的利率获得近50亿美元资金，无疑为其日益资本密集的业务提供了融资空间，同时也有现金用于偿还债务和其他公司需求。AMD目前的财务状况并不显得急切：截至2026年第二季度末，公司拥有约131亿美元的现金、现金等价物和短期投资，总债务为32亿美元，其中流动债务仅8.75亿美元。本次发行所得将远超其当前到期债务。

然而，AMD的业务正变得高度资本密集。截至2025年底，公司拥有约122亿美元的无条件承诺，包括晶圆和基板采购、多年期云服务协议、软件与技术许可，以及对第三方的担保义务，其中约85亿美元在2026年到期。同时，营运资金需求也在增长：截至第二季度末，库存约为84.7亿美元，应付账款攀升至53.6亿美元。2026年上半年，AMD在不动产和设备上的支出达到12亿美元，而去年同期为4.94亿美元。

如果猜测AMD可能将这笔资金投向何处，长期供应协议（如存储芯片、逻辑产能或先进封装）是最直接的选择。但考虑到当前市场现实，47.5亿美元仅为AMD 2026年第二季度末库存规模的约1/1.8（即库存约为这笔资金的1.8倍）。此外，根据美光近期财报中的说法，目前与主要存储厂商达成的长期供应协议平均金额已达71.4亿美元。因此，47.5亿美元可能不足以让AMD做出具有战略意义的大额采购承诺。不过，在全球各类供应普遍紧张的背景下，以优惠利率获得近50亿美元，确实为AMD的业务运营增添了一定的灵活空间。

history.content: Indonesia is taking charge of its AI future. This week, the Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi), Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison (Indosat or IOH), NVIDIA and Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM) launched the UGM Indosat NVIDIA AI Technology Center (NVAITC) in Yogyakarta — the country’s first university-based AI technology center. Established under Indonesia’s AI Center of Excellence initiative, UGM Indosat NVAITC brings government, industry and academia together to develop AI that addresses Indonesia’s most urgent national priorities. “The Indonesia AI Center of Excellence reflects our long-term vision to position Indonesia as a nation that not only adopts AI but also develops and contributes AI innovations to the world,” said Meutya Hafid, Indonesia’s Minister of Communication and Digital Affairs. “Through initiatives like this, we are laying the foundations of Indonesia’s AI sovereignty and ensuring AI becomes a driver of economic growth, national competitiveness and solutions to Indonesia’s most pressing challenges.” “UGM is committed to supporting Indonesia’s AI ambitions through education, research, and innovation that deliver real societal impact,” said Prof. dr. Ova Emilia, Ph.D. “This initiative supports national priorities in higher education, research downstreaming and talent development by accelerating the adoption of AI and preparing future-ready Indonesian talent.” Compute That Belongs to the Country Powered by NVIDIA’s full-stack AI platform and GPU Merdeka — Indosat’s sovereign GPU-as-a-service platform — UGM Indosat NVAITC gives UGM’s researchers and students access to enterprise-grade accelerated computing, AI software, open source, pretrained models, development frameworks and technical mentorship. It also connects Indonesian researchers to a worldwide ecosystem of expertise. “At Indosat, we believe no Indonesian should be left behind in the AI era,” said Vikram Sinha, president director and CEO of Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison. “Through UGM Indosat NVAITC, we are bringing the best of global AI technologies and expertise to Indonesia, while expanding access for the ecosystem of researchers, students, startups, and innovators across the country. By strengthening AI readiness and empowering Indonesian talent, we aim to support the government’s vision for AI and help position Indonesia not only as a user of AI technologies, but as a nation that develops and contributes AI innovations to the world.” The opportunity is real. Indonesia is the world’s fourth-most populous country, with researchers and developers working on problems of scale and urgency. What they’ve historically lacked is access to the compute, models and infrastructure to move from insight to impact. “Indonesia is home to an extraordinary community of researchers, developers and innovators with the potential to shape the future of AI,” said Marc Hamilton, vice president of solutions architecture and engineering at NVIDIA. “From healthcare and agriculture to disaster preparedness, the opportunities for AI to drive real change are immense. Through UGM Indosat NVIDIA AI Technology Center, NVIDIA is committed to equipping Indonesian talent with NVIDIA Nemotron open models and expertise to turn that potential into innovation with local and global impact.” AI for Indonesian Challenges Three initial projects define what this center is for, focused on healthcare, agriculture and natural disaster response. Indonesia records over 1 million new tuberculosis (TB) cases every year. TB is curable — but it kills when it goes undetected. Detection in rural and underserved areas has depended on equipment and expertise unavailable at the community level. UGM’s Faculty of Medicine Public Health and Nursing team, led by dr. Dian Kesumapramudya Nurputra, M.Sc, Ph.D, SpA , is developing an AI-powered electronic screening technology — eNose-TB — that screens for TB by analyzing breath samples. The goal: affordable, fast, accessible screening that reaches patients in remote clinics and villages — no specialist or expensive lab required. “As researchers, we have always believed that technology developed in Indonesia can solve Indonesian challenges,” said Dian. “Through the center, access to world-class AI infrastructure and expertise will help us accelerate our research and bring us closer to our dream of developing affordable and accessible healthcare technologies that can improve lives across Indonesia.” Agriculture employs nearly 30% of Indonesia’s workforce. SmartAgri uses multimodal AI — combining satellite imagery, sensor data and local agricultural knowledge — alongside edge computing to deliver precision farming for Indonesian terrain, crops and smallholders. These AI-powered recommendations help farmers know exactly when and how to irrigate, delivering impact that compounds over time. Indonesia sits on the Pacific Ring of Fire, facing more natural disaster risk than almost anywhere on earth. Tech4Disaster is building a geospatial AI platform using NVIDIA accelerated computing to process satellite and sensor data at speed — giving communities and emergency responders earlier warning, better situational awareness and faster coordination tools when disaster strikes. Learn more about the UGM Indosat NVIDIA AI Technology Center.

history.titleZh: Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat and NVIDIA Open Indonesia’s First University AI Center to Develop Local AI Talent
history.descriptionZh:
印度尼西亚正在加快掌控本国人工智能未来的步伐。本周，印尼通信与数字事务部（Komdigi）、运营商Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison（IOH）、英伟达（NVIDIA）与加查马达大学（UGM）在日惹共同启动了“UGM Indosat NVIDIA AI技术中心”（NVAITC），这是该国首个依托大学建立的AI技术中心。该中心是“印尼AI卓越中心”（Indonesia AI Center of Excellence）计划的一部分，旨在将政府、产业界和学术界的力量汇聚在一起，围绕印尼最紧迫的国家优先事项开发AI解决方案。

印尼通信与数字事务部长梅蒂亚·哈菲德（Meutya Hafid）表示，AI卓越中心体现了该国长期愿景，即让印尼不仅成为AI技术的采用者，更成为全球AI创新的开发者和贡献者。她强调，这类举措正在为印尼的“AI主权”奠定基础，确保AI成为经济增长、国家竞争力以及解决重大挑战的驱动力。UGM校长奥瓦·埃米利亚教授（Prof. dr. Ova Emilia）也表示，该中心通过加速AI应用和培养面向未来的人才，支持高等教育、研究转化和人才培养等国家优先事项。

从技术基础设施看，该中心由英伟达全栈AI平台和Indosat的“GPU Merdeka”——一个主权GPU即服务平台——提供算力支持。研究人员和学生可以获得企业级加速计算资源、AI软件、开源预训练模型、开发框架以及技术指导。中心还帮助印尼研究人员连接全球AI专家生态。Indosat总裁兼首席执行官维克拉姆·辛哈（Vikram Sinha）强调，他们希望让任何印尼人都能跟上AI时代的步伐，通过引入全球最先进的AI技术和专业知识，为国内的研究人员、学生、初创企业和创新者扩大机会。英伟达解决方案架构与工程副总裁马克·汉密尔顿（Marc Hamilton）则指出，印尼拥有非凡的研究者、开发者和创新者社区，而在医疗、农业、灾害应对等领域，AI变革潜力巨大。该中心将使用英伟达NVIDIA Nemotron开放模型和专业知识，帮助印尼人才把潜力转化为具有本地和全球影响力的创新。

中心首批启动的三个项目紧扣印尼本土挑战，覆盖医疗、农业和自然灾害响应。

在医疗领域，印尼每年新增超过100万例结核病（TB）病例。结核病本可治愈，但若未被及时发现则可能致命。在偏远和欠发达地区，检测往往依赖社区层面所不具备的设备和专业知识。UGM公共卫生与护理学院团队在Dian Kesumapramudya Nurputra博士的带领下，正在开发名为“eNose-TB”的AI电子筛查技术，通过分析呼吸样本来筛查结核病。其目标是提供廉价、快速、可及性强的筛查手段，让偏远诊所和村庄的患者无需专业医生或昂贵实验室即可获得检测。该技术有望大幅改善印尼结核病高负担地区的早期诊断率。

在农业方面，印尼近30%的劳动力从事农业。“SmartAgri”项目利用多模态AI——结合卫星图像、传感器数据和本地农业知识——以及边缘计算，为印尼的地形、作物和小农户提供精准农业方案。这些AI驱动的建议帮助农民准确掌握灌溉时机和方法，并通过长期累积产生持续的增产增效和资源节约效果。

在防灾领域，印尼位于环太平洋火山地震带，几乎比地球上任何地方都面临更多的自然灾害风险。“Tech4Disaster”项目正在构建一个地理空间AI平台，利用英伟达加速计算快速处理卫星和传感器数据，为社区和应急响应人员提供更早的预警、更强的态势感知以及更快的协调工具，从而在灾害发生时显著提升响应效率。

总体而言，UGM Indosat NVIDIA AI技术中心的成立，标志着印尼在推动AI主权、培养本土AI人才和解决国家关键问题方面迈出实质性一步。它通过将全球领先的AI基础设施、开放模型与本地研究需求深度结合，正在把印尼从单纯的AI用户转变为AI创新的参与者和贡献者，并为医疗、农业和减灾等关系国计民生的领域带来切实可行的先进解决方案。

history.title: Scythe Magoroku Review: excellent RAM thermals, but needs improvement elsewhere
history.description: Scythe is back with another dual-tower air cooler, the Magoroku. This cooler performs best with an Intel Arrow Lake system.
history.content: Unlike some of its cooler competitors, Chiba Japan-based Scythe is a fabless company that partners with factories in China and Taiwan for manufacturing of its air coolers, fans, and other PC hardware. The company has been delivering cooling products aimed largely at quiet performance for more than 20 years. We’ve enjoyed testing its previous products, like the fan-favorite FUMA 3 air cooler. Today we’re looking at Scythe’s latest offering, the Magoroku – a dual tower heatsink paired with two of Scythe’s Wonder Tornado 120 fans. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)The CPU cooler and fans are protected by molded foam and cardboard inserts. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Included with the package are:● Mounting hardware for AMD and Intel platforms● Three sets of fan clips● A small tube of thermal paste● Two 120mm Wonder Tornado fans● Screwdriver (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)AM5 InstallationTo begin putting things together, you’ll need to first remove the default AM4/5 retention mechanism. Next, place the studs over the exposed holes. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Afterwards, take the mounting bars and secure them with the included screws and screwdriver. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)It’s time to apply the thermal compound. If you’re not sure how to do that, we have a handy thermal paste application guide that covers the best methods you can use.After thermal paste is applied, take the CPU block and press it against the mounting bars, using the built-in screws and screwdriver to secure it in place. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Finally, you’ll want to attach both fans using the clips included with the cooler and connect them to the motherboard’s PWM header. If you have tall system RAM, I advise moving the front fan and placing it in the rear for best thermal performance. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Real-world testing configuration on AMD’s AM5 platformWe’ve tested coolers with both the Ryzen 9950X3D and its non-V-Cache sibling, the 9950X. There are some differences in how the 9950X and 9950X3D CPUs are impacted by thermal events. While the heat output of the CCDs of AMD’s 9950X3D is relatively balanced, the 9950X I used has one CCD that runs much hotter than the other, with a difference of over 10 degrees Celsius in some scenarios, shown below. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)We’ve since returned to using a 9950X3D for cooler testing, as it has a more balanced heat profile, and is almost certainly a more widely adopted CPU. The benchmark results shared in these reviews may differ from others because I emphasize results that are comparable to real-world use. This means I generally test CPU coolers inside of a closed desktop case, which increases cooling difficulty compared to other testing methods.Many reviewers test coolers on open test benches, which have a combination of lesser airflow needs and lowered ambient temperatures. This results in making weak coolers appear stronger than they really are. Some publications have also used generic thermal plates to test cooling solutions. I reject both of these methods because they don’t accurately reflect real-world cooler conditions. history.titleZh: Scythe Magoroku 评测：内存散热表现出色，但其他方面仍需改进
history.descriptionZh:
日本千叶的Scythe（镰刀）是一家无晶圆厂PC硬件厂商，与中台工厂合作生产空气散热器、风扇等产品，20余年来一直专注于安静性能表现，其此前的FUMA 3风冷散热器广受好评。本次评测的是Scythe最新型号Magoroku——一款双塔散热器，标配两把Wonder Tornado 120风扇，官方建议零售价42.99美元，目前亚马逊售价38.69美元，属于中端风冷产品。

Magoroku采用双塔鳍片设计，六根铜热管将CPU热量传导至两侧散热鳍片。整机尺寸为134×142.5×155mm，兼容AMD AM5/AM4和Intel LGA 1700/1851/1200/115x平台。散热器不配备RGB灯效，质保期为一年。标配的风扇为120mm Wonder Tornado，转速区间300–2000 RPM，风量60.29 CFM，风压2.45 mmH2O，厚度26mm。

内存兼容性是这款散热器的设计亮点之一。官方参数标称支持57mm以下高度的内存，但若在前方安装标配风扇，高马甲内存会与风扇产生遮挡，影响散热效率。评测者建议的最佳方案是：将前置风扇移至散热器后部、主板VRM散热片上方，这样既能获得最佳散热性能，又能完全兼容高内存，不会对DIMM槽产生任何干涉。

安装过程：在AM5平台上，先移除原装扣具，放置螺柱并固定安装条，涂抹硅脂后将CPU底座用自带螺丝固定，最后通过风扇夹安装两把风扇并连接到主板PWM接口。包装内附赠了AMD和Intel平台安装套件、三组风扇夹、一管硅脂、两把风扇和一把螺丝刀。

值得注意的测试方法：评测者强调自己坚持在封闭机箱内测试，而不是使用开放式测试台或通用均热板，因为后两种方法会低估散热器在真实机箱中的散热难度，使弱散热器显得更强。测试平台采用AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D、MSI X870E Carbon主板、TeamGroup DDR5-7200内存、MSI RTX 4070Ti Super显卡，机箱为Tryx FLOVA F50（独特横流风扇设计，另加一把Noctua NF-A12 G2进风扇）。之所以选用9950X3D而非9950X，是因为前者CCD发热更均衡，更贴近主流用户实际使用情况。

实测性能：在封闭机箱环境下，Magoroku在全速风扇下可压制超过236W的CPU功耗；在噪音归一化测试（将风扇转速调整至标准噪音水平）中，平均可处理超过228W功耗。考虑到其40美元左右的价位，这款散热器在静音、兼容性和散热能力之间取得了不错的平衡，有望进入最佳CPU散热器推荐榜单。对于希望搭配高端Ryzen处理器并追求安静运行的用户，Magoroku是一个值得考虑的选项。不过最终性能评级还需结合完整的风扇曲线、噪音实测以及与其他同价位产品的横向对比来判断。

history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 7 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Cargo thieves knocked two private security escort vehicles out of action on California roads in recent months, then made off with millions of dollars in AI data center hardware the escorts were guarding, according to a WIRED investigation. Both shipments were traveling from Silicon Valley to Southern California, and neither truck has been recovered. The attacks come as cargo theft losses across the U.S. and Canada more than doubled year over year to $304.6 million in Q2 2026, and as restricted Nvidia servers sell in China for roughly twice their U.S. retail price.Gerardo Pachuca, a former Los Angeles sheriff's detective who now consults on cargo crime, told WIRED that one escort was rear-ended by a driver who fled the scene, while the other was spun off the road with a PIT maneuver, the same tactic police use to end car chases. Once the escorts were disabled, the semitrucks kept driving and disappeared. Investigators believe the truck drivers were complicit, with both thefts involving motor carrier numbers that had recently changed hands, a fraud technique that lets criminals book freight under a legitimate company's federal registration. "It's the worst I've seen," Pachuca said of cargo theft nationwide.WIRED couldn't confirm the incidents with five state and local law enforcement agencies, but two freight security figures corroborated them: J.J. Coughlin, chairman of the Southwest Transportation Security Council, and Danny Ramon, director of intelligence and response at freight-monitoring firm Overhaul.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Verisk CargoNet documented 677 supply chain theft incidents in the U.S. and Canada in Q2 2026, down 26% from a year earlier, yet estimated losses jumped from $135.7 million to $304.6 million over the same period, according to a recent report by the firm. The average theft with a reported value hit $564,009. "Lower incident volume should not be mistaken for lower risk," said Keith Lewis, vice president of operations at Verisk CargoNet.Enterprise computing and networking equipment ranks among the most targeted categories, and Verisk noted that shipments worth several million dollars routinely move as conventional dry freight with no special security. Recoveries this summer included $550,000 in Celestica-built server switches destined for Meta and roughly $1 million in data center equipment found in a trailer outside Chicago. You may like Cargo thieves target AI data center supplies in $1.3 million heists Nvidia employee implicated in escalating AI GPU smuggling scandal Taiwan raids 12 locations in its first formal crackdown on Nvidia AI chip smuggling Freight investigators, including Pachuca, told WIRED that location pings from stolen components suggest many shipments end up overseas. Stolen cargo normally fences at a steep discount, but U.S. export controls have pushed black market prices in China far above American retail: Nvidia's DGX B300 server sells there for more than $1.1 million against a U.S. price of roughly $550,000, and even five-year-old A100 servers have tripled in price. A hijacked truckload of restricted AI hardware is one of the few categories of stolen goods that can be worth more on the black market than off of it. history.titleZh: Cargo thieves ram security escorts to hijack AI hardware shipments in California — brazen thieves employ PIT maneuver, rear-ending tactics to secure goods for the black market
history.descriptionZh:
近期美国加州发生两起针对AI数据中心硬件运输的精心策划的劫案。据WIRED调查，两辆私人安保护送车在公路上被撞毁，护送的价值数百万美元的AI数据中心硬件被劫走。两批货物均从硅谷运往南加州，目前卡车均未找回。这些攻击发生之际，北美地区货物盗窃损失在2026年第二季度同比增长一倍以上，达到3.046亿美元，而受限的Nvidia服务器在中国黑市售价约为美国零售价的两倍。

前洛杉矶县警探Gerardo Pachuca介绍，其中一辆护卫车被肇事逃逸的司机追尾，另一辆则被PIT机动（警方用来结束追车战的战术）撞出道路。护卫车辆瘫痪后，半挂卡车继续行驶并消失。调查人员认为卡车司机是同谋，两起盗窃案都涉及近期易手的承运商编号。这是一种欺诈技术，犯罪分子可利用合法公司的联邦注册信息预订货运。Pachuca称这是他所见过最严重的货物盗窃。

WIRED未能从五个州和地方执法机构获得确认，但两位货运安全人士证实了事件。Verisk CargoNet报告显示，2026年Q2美国和加拿大共记录677起供应链盗窃事件，同比下降26%，但估计损失从1.357亿美元跃升至3.046亿美元。有报告价值的盗窃案平均损失达56.4万美元。Verisk副总裁Keith Lewis表示，事件数量降低不应被误认为风险降低。企业计算和网络设备是最常被盯上的类别之一，价值数百万美元的货物经常以普通干货运输，没有特殊安保。今年夏天追回的物品包括价值55万美元、为Meta制造的Celestica服务器交换机，以及在芝加哥附近拖车内发现的约100万美元数据中心设备。

货运调查人员指出，被盗部件的定位信号显示许多货物最终流向海外。通常赃物以折扣价销赃，但美国出口管制推高了中国黑市价格：Nvidia DGX B300服务器在中国售价超过110万美元，而美国零售价约55万美元；即使是五年前的A100服务器价格也已涨了三倍。因此，一整车受限AI硬件是少数在黑市上比合法市场更值钱的赃物。这起事件凸显了AI芯片供应链面临的新安全挑战。

history.title: Older Raptor Lake CPUs are a ‘core part of the portfolio’ for years to come, says Intel — there’s been a ‘sudden inrush of demand’ for LGA 1700 chips due to DDR5 prices
history.description: Intel has seen a “sudden inrush” of demand for Raptor Lake CPUs, and it says they’ll remain a part of the company’s lineup for desktop builders “for years to come.”
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 9 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Intel’s Robert Hallock, vice president and general manager of Intel’s enthusiast channel business, told Tom’s Hardware Premium in an interview that the Raptor Lake architecture will be part of Intel’s offerings “for years to come.” Intel has no plans to abandon Raptor Lake, and if anything, the company says it’s working to “smooth out” some of the supply and pricing inconsistencies among the range. Raptor Lake CPUs still rank among the best CPUs for gaming, not only due to the underperforming Arrow Lake (not Refresh), but also due to high DDR5 prices.Go deeper with TH Premium: CPU (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)CPU scaling with DLSSRyzen to the top: How AMD innovated in the gaming CPU marketHow ARM is working its way into PCsAMD CES 2026 gaming trends press Q&A roundtable transcript“Going forward, 10nm products like Raptor Lake; that is a core part of the portfolio that I want to offer to people for years to come,” said Hallock. “LGA 1700 is still a good socket. Lots of people [are] still interested in DDR4, so [we’ll] keep offering, and you'll see [pricing] smooth out over time. It'll come back to normal. That's the plan.”Raptor Lake has become a key part of Intel’s roadmap as the RAM shortage strangles budget builders from upgrading to a DDR5 platform. In June, Tom’s Hardware first reported on motherboard manufacturers increasing production of DDR4-based boards with the LGA 1700 socket (the socket Raptor Lake CPUs use), and we’re seeing those products roll out now. Just days ago, in fact, Gigabyte introduced a new LGA 1700 board with DDR4 support.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Motherboards were one issue with Raptor Lake on DDR4 platforms; there were never a ton of LGA 1700 motherboards with DDR4 support to begin with. They were something of a stopgap with 12th-Gen Alder Lake CPUs as Intel transitioned to DDR5, largely falling out of favor (and inventory) as Raptor Lake rolled out and DDR5 prices started coming down. Obviously we’re living in a much different world now.But as the DDR5 pricing crisis started hitting, Raptor Lake inventory started faltering, in part due to increased demand (at least according to Hallock), and likely also in part due to the gradual phasing out of older products. Today, the pricing situation with Raptor Lake is problematic. The Core i5-14600K, for example, sold for $200 or less for the better part of last year. It’s since jumped to around $250, if you can find it in stock at all. At the time of writing, it’s on backorder at Newegg and $262 at Amazon. Similarly, the Core i7-14700K should be selling for around $330, but it’s $380 at Newegg at the time of writing and sold out at Amazon. Again, for the majority of last year, the 14700K often sold for less than $350. You may like Intel reportedly preparing surprise return to DDR4 systems with 'Raptor Lake Next' Intel's upcoming Raptor Lake Next will reportedly top out at 20 cores and retain Core 200 branding Re-examining the DDR4 gaming gap with Intel’s LGA 1700 CPUs in mid-2026 This wobbly inventory and pricing situation is due to the “sudden inrush of demand” for Raptor Lake CPUs as the RAM pricing crisis started to take hold, and Intel didn’t see it coming. “If people are going to go to more affordable hardware, they still want the fastest available for their money, and that happened to be Alder Lake and Raptor Lake. So there was a sudden inrush of demand into these parts — certainly not anticipated when you start your wafers, and your builds, long before that moment ever happens. So it's very hard to predict,” Hallock said.And Raptor Lake CPUs do remain top DDR4 performers. In our recent re-review of the Ryzen 7 5800X3D, the Core i7-14700K and 13700K matched the 5800X3D in games, all three of which were using DDR4, and offered much better application performance. In our recent comparison of DDR4 against DDR5 across Intel’s LGA 1700 stack, we found that DDR4 is the major bottleneck in games, which is something even the 5800X3D can’t overcome.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsHallock indicates that we’ll see an increase in Raptor Lake inventory, though he didn’t specify what that inventory will look like. As Tom’s Hardware first reported in June, motherboard vendors are gearing up for “Raptor Lake Next,” which is supposedly another slate of refreshes set to launch at the beginning of next year. There are also Bartlett Lake processors that use strictly P-cores, exclusively for embedded applications. Although they haven’t made their way to DIY desktops, the range shows that Intel continues to produce 10nm products and likely will for several years in the future.Although Intel is making efforts to improve Raptor Lake supply — be that through more stock or Raptor Lake Next — that isn’t coming at the cost of next-gen Nova Lake parts. Hallock indicated that Intel, as well as the industry more broadly, is looking at splitting mainstream and enthusiast offerings due to pricing pressure elsewhere in the market. You can read the transcript of the full interview at our Tom's Hardware Premium site. history.titleZh: 英特尔表示，较老的Raptor Lake CPU在未来几年仍是‘产品组合的核心部分’——由于DDR5价格，LGA 1700芯片出现了‘突发需求涌入’
history.descriptionZh:
英特尔副总裁兼发烧友渠道业务总经理Robert Hallock在接受Tom’s Hardware Premium采访时明确表示，Raptor Lake架构将成为英特尔未来数年产品组合的核心组成部分，公司没有放弃这一架构的打算，反而正在努力解决当前该系列产品在供应和定价上的混乱局面。尽管Arrow Lake（非Refresh版本）表现不及预期，加上DDR5内存价格居高不下，Raptor Lake处理器依然是游戏领域的最佳选择之一。

Hallock在采访中指出：“面向未来，像Raptor Lake这样的10nm产品是我希望长期提供给用户的核心组合。LGA 1700仍然是一个优秀的插槽，很多人依然对DDR4感兴趣，所以我们会继续提供相关产品，你会看到价格随时间逐渐趋于平稳，最终恢复正常。这就是我们的计划。”这番表态的背景是，DDR5内存短缺正严重制约预算型装机用户向DDR5平台升级，Raptor Lake因此成为英特尔路线图上的关键一环。

事实上，早在6月份，Tom’s Hardware就曾报道过主板厂商正在提高采用LGA 1700插槽的DDR4主板产量——LGA 1700正是Raptor Lake所用的插槽。如今这些产品已经陆续上市，就在几天前，技嘉还推出了一款支持DDR4的新LGA 1700主板。过去，支持DDR4的LGA 1700主板数量一直不多，它们在12代酷睿Alder Lake时代作为英特尔向DDR5过渡的权宜之计存在，但随着Raptor Lake推出和DDR5价格下降，这些主板逐渐失宠并退出了库存。如今情况则完全不同。

随着DDR5价格危机加剧，Raptor Lake本身的库存也开始吃紧，部分原因是需求增加（至少按Hallock的说法如此），部分原因可能是旧产品逐渐停产。当前Raptor Lake的定价问题相当突出：例如酷睿i5-14600K去年大部分时间售价在200美元或更低，现在却涨到约250美元，还常常缺货。截至撰稿时，该处理器在Newegg上处于缺货状态，在亚马逊上标价262美元。同样，酷睿i7-14700K原本应在330美元左右，现在Newegg上标价380美元，亚马逊则已售罄，而去年大部分时间它经常低于350美元。

Hallock将这种不稳定的库存和价格状况归因于内存价格危机开始后Raptor Lake需求的“突然涌入”，而英特尔对此毫无预料。“如果人们打算转向更经济的硬件，他们仍然希望在同等预算下获得最快的产品，而恰好在当时最合适的就是Alder Lake和Raptor Lake。因此这些部件出现了突然的需求激增——当你开始晶圆投片和生产备货时，很难预料到未来会发生什么，所以这非常难以预测。”

从性能角度看，Raptor Lake依然是DDR4平台上的顶级存在。在我们近期对Ryzen 7 5800X3D的重新评测中，酷睿i7-14700K和13700K在游戏性能上与5800X3D持平，三者均使用DDR4内存，而英特尔芯片还提供了明显更好的应用性能。在我们另一项针对英特尔LGA 1700产品线的DDR4与DDR5对比测试中发现，DDR4是游戏中的主要瓶颈，这是连5800X3D也无法克服的。

Hallock表示Raptor Lake的库存会得到改善，但他没有具体说明未来的库存规模。正如Tom’s Hardware在6月首次报道的那样，主板厂商正在为“Raptor Lake Next”做准备——这据称是定于明年年初发布的又一波刷新产品。此外还有仅使用P核、专供嵌入式应用的Bartlett Lake处理器。虽然它们尚未进入DIY桌面市场，但该产品线表明英特尔仍在持续生产10nm产品，且很可能在未来数年都会如此。

值得注意的是，尽管英特尔在努力改善Raptor Lake的供应——无论是通过增加库存还是推出Raptor Lake Next——这并不会以牺牲下一代Nova Lake部件为代价。Hallock指出，英特尔乃至更广泛的行业正考虑将主流产品与发烧友产品线分离开来，以应对市场其他方面的定价压力。完整访谈实录可在Tom’s Hardware Premium网站查阅。

history.title: Nvidia Jetson chip found in Russian cruise missile, Ukraine claims — presence in S-71 'Monochrome' weapon may indicate use of AI tech
history.description: Ukraine intelligence claims that Russia's latest S-71 'Monochrome' cruise missiles use Nvidia's Jetson Orin NX modules with AI capabilities, allegedly for terminal guidance.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 3 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Russia's latest S-71 'Monochrome' cruise missiles use Nvidia's Jetson Orin modules with artificial intelligence capabilities, the Main Directorate of Intelligence of the Ministry of Defense of Ukraine claimed on Wednesday. The S-71 'Monochrome' is distinguished by reduced observability and autonomous targeting capability, reports Militarnyi. Nvidia says the Jetson Orin is a consumer-grade device that is not export-controlled and is not officially available in Russia.According to the claims, the module in question carries an Nvidia chip marked as SNVUP6.MOP TE980M-A1 and resembles the Jetson Orin NX 8GB/16GB system-on-module. The Orin NX is an automotive-grade SoM based on a system-on-chip featuring up to eight Arm Cortex-A78AE cores, a GPU featuring Ampere architecture with 1024 CUDA cores and 32 Tensor cores that provide up to 157 sparse INT8 TOPS performance for AI, dedicated NVDLA engines, and a vision accelerator. The unit has been shipping since 2023, though based on the markings on the chip purportedly found in the missile, it was packaged in March, 2025."Our Jetson Orin modules are consumer-grade products sold to students, developers, and startups for a wide range of beneficial applications," an Nvidia spokesperson told Tom's Hardware. "They are not available in Russia and are not designed for military purposes. Pre-owned Jetsons are available through many reseller channels. Although we cannot track products after they are sold, if we determine that any customer is violating U.S. export controls, we will take appropriate action."Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Nvidia positions Jetson Orin NX as a solution for space- and power-constrained applications that need vision, but cannot accommodate more powerful and power-hungry solutions, which essentially means drones and mobile robots that work on battery power. Conceptually, an Orin NX could function as a dedicated electro-optical perception computer that can recognize images locally and pass the information to a separate flight-control/guidance system.In the S-71 'Monochrome' missile, capabilities of Nvidia's Jetson Orin NX are potentially useful as the compute engine behind an electro-optical perception system (based on a Honpho TS130C-01 module that is made in China) that recognizes images in real time and assists terminal guidance. As per Militarnyi, the S-71M 'Monochrome' can be fired from Su-57 fighters or S-70 Okhotnik drones. With a range of up to 300km, it carries a 250k high-explosive fragmentation bomb as its payload. You may like Chinese military has been acquiring Nvidia chips, even post-Washington export controls, research claims China's Moonshot AI reportedly used Nvidia Blackwell chips for training Kimi K3 Jensen Huang slams 'stupid' analogy comparing GPUs to nuclear weapons Previously, Ukrainian intelligence reported that Russia used Nvidia's Jetson Orin NX modules in its Shahed MS001 autonomous drones for local decision-making and terminal guidance.Nvidia's Jetson Orin NX modules have been shipping since 2023 and are widely available, which means that Nvidia sells hundreds of thousands, if not millions, every year. Meanwhile, the majority of Jetson Orin NX-based products available in retail are not the SoMs themselves, but rather small-form-factor systems or development kits. The modules are available too, though not as widely. For example, a German store sells them for €685 with a 19% VAT.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsIn any case, while the American government does export control for high-end AI accelerators like Nvidia's H100 or B200, which can be used to train AI models that can later be used for military purposes, it does not export control hardware that can run these models locally. Ultimately, the models are trained anyway, and the hardware that can use them is readily available. history.titleZh: 乌克兰声称在俄罗斯巡航导弹中发现英伟达Jetson芯片——S-71“单色”武器中的存在可能表明使用了AI技术
history.descriptionZh:
乌克兰国防部情报总局近日声称，俄罗斯最新型的S-71“Monochrome”（单色）巡航导弹中集成了英伟达（Nvidia）的Jetson Orin人工智能模块，用于提升导弹的自主目标识别与制导能力。这一消息由乌克兰军事媒体Militarnyi率先披露，并引发了关于商用AI芯片在军事武器中应用及出口管制有效性的讨论。

据乌克兰方面公布的信息，俄军在S-71导弹中使用的芯片标记为“SNVUP6.MOP TE980M-A1”，外观与英伟达Jetson Orin NX 8GB/16GB系统级模块（SoM）高度吻合。该模块基于英伟达Orin系统级芯片（SoC）设计，集成多达8个Arm Cortex-A78AE处理器核心，以及基于Ampere架构的GPU，内含1024个CUDA核心和32个Tensor核心，可提供高达157 TOPS（稀疏INT8精度）的AI算力，并配备专用的NVDLA深度学习加速引擎和视觉加速器。该系列模块自2023年起量产推向市场，但导弹中发现的这颗芯片封装日期显示为2025年3月，意味着其供应链很可能在近期仍能向俄罗斯输送此类硬件。

英伟达公司回应称，Jetson Orin模块属于消费级产品，面向学生、开发者及初创公司设计，并非军用产品，且英伟达不在俄罗斯官方销售该产品。不过，英伟达也承认，该模块并非出口管制对象，且大量二手或转售渠道流通的模块难以追踪。公司强调，一旦确认客户违反美国出口管制政策，将采取适当行动。

S-71“Monochrome”巡航导弹的突出特点在于低可观测性（隐身设计）和自主目标捕获能力。导弹射程可达300公里，可搭载一枚250公斤级高爆杀伤战斗部，并可由苏-57战斗机或S-70“猎人”无人战机发射。据分析，导弹内部搭载的Jetson Orin NX模块充当“光电感知计算大脑”，配合一个中国制造的Honpho TS130C-01光电传感器模块，在飞行末端对目标图像进行实时识别与匹配，从而在不依赖外部数据链或GPS信号的情况下实现“发射后不管”的精确打击。Jetson Orin NX的低功耗、小体积特性，使其非常适合部署在电池供电无人机或便携式武器平台上。

这并非俄罗斯首次在武器系统中使用英伟达AI模块。此前乌克兰情报部门就曾报告，俄军在Shahed MS001型自杀式无人机中也使用了Jetson Orin NX模块，用于本地目标识别和末端制导决策。这说明无论是高端智能弹药还是低成本巡飞弹，俄军都在尝试利用商用AI硬件实现自主作战能力。

从全球硬件流通角度看，Jetson Orin NX模块自2023年开始大规模发货，年销量达数十万甚至上百万件。零售市场上常见的往往是基于该模块的整机或开发套件，裸模块也并非难以获取。例如，有德国零售商公开出售该模块，含19%增值税后售价约685欧元。这一状况折射出当前出口管制体系的一个结构性漏洞：美国政府对英伟达H100、B200等高端AI训练加速器实施严格出口管制，因为这些芯片可用于训练军事AI模型，但对于运行这些模型的边缘推理硬件，如Jetson系列，却并未纳入管制清单。最终结果就是，AI模型可以通过受管制的设备在合法渠道训练出来，而能够部署模型的推理硬件却可轻易流入任何市场。

综上，S-71导弹中发现的英伟达AI模块不仅揭示了商业AI芯片在战场上的快速渗透，也再次引发了对全球AI硬件流通监管的质疑。随着自主武器系统日益依赖商用边缘计算平台，如何平衡技术开放与安全风险，将成为各国政策制定者必须面对的难题。

history.title: AMD borrows $4.75 billion for 'general corporate purposes' — company gives no insight into how it plans to spend cash injection
history.description: In a surprising move, AMD announces plans to raise $4.75 billion and does not give a clue how it plans to spend them.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Coming on the heels of Intel's $19.7 billion common stock offering from earlier this week, AMD on Thursday announced plans to borrow $4.75 billion through a new senior unsecured debt offering. AMD does not tie the proceeds to a particular project, saying they will be available for general corporate purposes, including potentially paying down existing debt. Meanwhile, the increasing capital intensity of the industry gives AMD numerous options to use the money."We intend to use the net proceeds from this offering for general corporate purposes, which may include the repayment of debt," an AMD statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission reads.The offering comprises four tranches: $1.25 billion of 4.6% notes due in 2029; $1.50 billion of 5% notes due in 2031; $1 billion of 5.25% notes due in 2033; and $1 billion of 5.5% notes due in 2036. Their yields to maturity are 4.64%, 5.018%, 5.264%, and 5.532%, respectively, while spreads over comparable U.S. Treasuries range from 43 to 90 basis points, which indicates that the market is generally confident in AMD and is willing to lend it money at rates that barely exceed those of the U.S. Treasury. Moody's and S&P are expected to rate the securities A1 and A, respectively.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: AMD did not disclose how it plans to spend $4.75 billion, but the additional money obtained at attractive rates gives it room to finance its increasingly capital-intensive business as well as cash for debt repayment and other corporate requirements.AMD hardly appears desperate for additional money. At the end of Q2 2026, the company had approximately $13.1 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments. AMD's debt totaled $3.2 billion, and only $875 million is classified as current, which means that the proceeds from the offering by far exceed AMD's current obligations. Meanwhile, AMD's business is becoming very capital intensive. You may like Intel raises $19.7 billion to help fund future projects as 14A production looms AMD confirmed $5.4 billion ATI acquisition 20 years ago today Record-high pricing pushes SSD and memory makers to borrow $880 million just to afford buying chips At the end of 2025, the company had around $12.2 billion in unconditional commitments, which include purchases of wafers and substrates, multi-year cloud-service agreements, software and technology licenses, and guaranteed obligations to third parties. Approximately $8.5 billion was due in 2026.Also, AMD's working capital requirements are growing. Inventories reached approximately $8.47 billion by the end of Q2, while accounts payable climbed to $5.36 billion. AMD also spent $1.20 billion on property and equipment during the first half of 2026, compared with $494 million a year earlier.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsIf we were to speculate where AMD can put $4.75 billion, then long-term supply agreements for commodities like memory, logic production, or advanced packaging immediately come to mind. However, given the current market realities, $4.75 billion is 1.8x smaller than AMD's inventories as of late Q2 2026. Furthermore, an average long-term supply deal with a major memory maker now amounts to $7.14 billion (according to Micron's comments made in its recent earnings release).That said, $4.75 billion may not be enough for AMD to make strategically important purchase commitments. Nonetheless, getting nearly $5 billion at attractive rates amid global undersupply of pretty much everything certainly gives AMD some additional flexibility to run its business. history.titleZh: AMD borrows $4.75 billion for 'general corporate purposes' — company gives no insight into how it plans to spend cash injection
history.descriptionZh:
在英特尔本周早些时候宣布通过普通股发行筹集197亿美元之后，AMD于周四跟进，计划通过新的高级无担保债务发行借款47.5亿美元。AMD并未将这笔资金与特定项目挂钩，表示将用于一般公司用途，其中可能包括偿还现有债务。随着行业资本密集度不断上升，这笔资金为AMD提供了多种使用选择。

根据AMD提交给美国证券交易委员会（SEC）的声明，本次发行分为四个批次：12.5亿美元票面利率4.6%的2029年到期票据；15亿美元票面利率5%的2031年到期票据；10亿美元票面利率5.25%的2033年到期票据；以及10亿美元票面利率5.5%的2036年到期票据。对应到期收益率分别为4.64%、5.018%、5.264%和5.532%，相较同期限美国国债的利差在43至90个基点之间。这表明市场对AMD的信用状况总体有信心，愿意以略高于美国国债的利率向其放贷。穆迪和标普预计将分别给予此次发行的证券A1和A的评级。

AMD没有披露47.5亿美元的具体使用计划，但以如此有吸引力的利率获得近50亿美元资金，无疑为其日益资本密集的业务提供了融资空间，同时也有现金用于偿还债务和其他公司需求。AMD目前的财务状况并不显得急切：截至2026年第二季度末，公司拥有约131亿美元的现金、现金等价物和短期投资，总债务为32亿美元，其中流动债务仅8.75亿美元。本次发行所得将远超其当前到期债务。

然而，AMD的业务正变得高度资本密集。截至2025年底，公司拥有约122亿美元的无条件承诺，包括晶圆和基板采购、多年期云服务协议、软件与技术许可，以及对第三方的担保义务，其中约85亿美元在2026年到期。同时，营运资金需求也在增长：截至第二季度末，库存约为84.7亿美元，应付账款攀升至53.6亿美元。2026年上半年，AMD在不动产和设备上的支出达到12亿美元，而去年同期为4.94亿美元。

如果猜测AMD可能将这笔资金投向何处，长期供应协议（如存储芯片、逻辑产能或先进封装）是最直接的选择。但考虑到当前市场现实，47.5亿美元仅为AMD 2026年第二季度末库存规模的约1/1.8（即库存约为这笔资金的1.8倍）。此外，根据美光近期财报中的说法，目前与主要存储厂商达成的长期供应协议平均金额已达71.4亿美元。因此，47.5亿美元可能不足以让AMD做出具有战略意义的大额采购承诺。不过，在全球各类供应普遍紧张的背景下，以优惠利率获得近50亿美元，确实为AMD的业务运营增添了一定的灵活空间。
